[[Lord/Legends|Lord]] '''Iuaway''' was a ground forces commander who worked for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was from an urbanized [[Planet/Legends|world]], and attended a briefing on ground force command hosted by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Crix Madine/Legends|Crix Madine]].
